task: Check if a visa is required to work in the UK for longer than 6 months in Healthcare as an American citizen.
agent_final_answer:
Yes - a visa is required. An American (US) citizen who wants to come to the UK to work in Healthcare for longer than 6 months needs a UK work visa (specifically a Health and Care Worker visa, a category of the Skilled Worker visa). Per the GOV.UK "Check if you need a UK visa" guidance, US nationals coming to work for more than 6 months must apply for and obtain a visa before travelling.
